clips.name: Day4_clip10_silence
lines: Okay, I like it. So what's the price?
[confident] The full program is two thousand dollars.
[hesitant] Two thousand... wow. That's... I mean... [unsure] okay. When can I start?
[calm] Monday. I'll send you the details now.

[serious] Did you see that? After the price, he said nothing. Silence feels awkward, so most people rush to fill it with a discount. Don't. Say the price, then stop talking. Whoever speaks first after the price usually loses. It's inside Sales Master. Link in bio.

clips.name: Day4_clip11_sellingishelping
clips.text: [serious] If you think selling is pushy, listen to this. [calm] If your product really helps people, and you don't offer it, who wins? Nobody. They keep the problem. You keep the solution in your pocket. That's not polite. That's selfish. [confident] Selling is helping. You show them a better option, and you let them decide. Every pitch you avoid is a person you didn't help. Believe in what you sell, or sell something else. Follow. One sales skill every day.

clips.name: Day4_clip12_thinkaboutit
lines: This sounds good. But I need to think about it.
[calm] Totally fair. What exactly do you need to think about?
[hesitant] Well... it's the money. It's a lot right now.
[confident] Got it. So if the money worked, you'd want to start?

[serious] I need to think about it is almost never the real objection. It's a polite exit. Don't argue with it, and don't let them leave with it. Ask one calm question. What exactly do you need to think about? Then the real objection shows up, and now you can handle it. It's inside Sales Master. Link in bio.

clips.name: Day4_clip13_status
clips.text: [confident] The person who needs the deal more, loses. [calm] Customers can feel it. When you chase, discount, and beg, you look desperate. And desperate looks risky. [serious] So flip it. You're the expert. You ask the questions. You decide if they're a good fit. You're ready to walk away. That calm energy is what makes people trust you. Stop begging for the sale. Lead it. The full system is inside Sales Master. Link in bio.
